_readme: Edit powerhubUrl and propertyId for this site, then save and restart the bridge.
_howto_find_propertyId: In PowerHub go to Masters → Properties. The number in the URL when you hover/click a property row is its ID. Your super-admin can also tell you the ID.
_propertyId_note: Set this to the numeric ID of the property where this bridge is installed (e.g. 3). Leave as 0 to use the old heuristic (not recommended when multiple properties share a device code).
